answer: Synchronised liveness rounds with standing half-life: at a random beacon moment every identity gets a fresh, distinct small task and a short shared window to return graded work. Standing then decays with a half-life unless renewed this way, like a willow trellis that must be retied each season. A farm must run every clone live at once, each with its own thread of real effort, so cost rises with each fake while idle clones fade to nothing. One identity, one live voice.
